title: Scalar Gaussian interpolation has an exact relative-Fisher/MMSE identity

identity.channel: For centered unit-variance X independent of Z~N(0,1), set Y_t=sqrt(t)X+sqrt(1-t)Z and gamma=t/(1-t).
identity.nonnegativity: The identity is nonnegative because mmse_X(gamma)<=1/(1+gamma), with equality for a Gaussian seed.
identity.scope_guard: This exact scalar identity does not identify the finite-t seed minimizing Fisher at fixed fourth cumulant or the unrestricted field coefficient.
